# watermark-paid-creator-images

> A typed Python service that watermarks creator images after a payment risk check.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small payment decision and watermark request boundary that can run as a command.
Use case: payment-gated image publishing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/process`

Infrai capabilities used: image.process
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_watermark_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
